purpose: Finalization-only inventory of existing betting, EDGE, ROI, uncertainty, and prospective-settlement evidence. No new training, tuning, backtest, web research, or post-race settlement was run to create this file.
executive_findings: Across the current v11 validation-locked seven-bet policies, confirmed absolute-profit bet types are 0/7 for both full-rank and market-anchor families.

On the later-date optional fresh64 settlement, the five-feature model has 0/7 confirmed absolute-profit bet types and 0/7 Holm-confirmed paired advantages; the only positive point ROI is exacta at +0.9375%, with a daily-block interval of [-82.95%, +94.78%].
The separate six-feature M6 fresh64 settlement has no positive point ROI among the seven bet types and 0/7 Holm-confirmed paired advantages.

The strongest defensive result is retrospective 8-15 closing-odds place betting: the fixed-lock model ROI is +1.30% with CI [-18.65%, +21.96%], while its same-race market control ROI is -30.50%; paired advantage is +31.80% with CI [+10.51%, +53.76%] and Holm pass. This is not absolute-profit confirmation and is not pristine because TEST was previously inspected and prices are closing values.
The v11 8-15 validation-threshold test gives +9.79% ROI on 94 bets, but CI [-46.31%, +74.21%]; the historical +32.69% point estimate was not reproduced at the same magnitude.

The v11 upset-feature grid contains 22/56 point estimates at or above +30% ROI, but 0/56 have a positive 95% CI lower bound and 0/56 pass FDR. Large complex-bet figures are therefore descriptive, fragile, and not deployable.

The 2026-08-23 preregistered T-5 pipeline was still active and unsettled at this inventory time: 17/17 races were waiting, frozen prospective score/ticket races were 0, target outcome/dividend rows read were 0, network settlement calls were 0, and live stake was 0.

Probability information improvement is more repeatable than profit: several market-anchor models have positive DeltaLL, but conversion to executable ROI is blocked by uncertainty, reused samples, closing-price timing, and absent pre-bet combination grids.

definitions.market_probability: For runner i in race r, q_ri = (1 / O_ri) / sum_j(1 / O_rj), where O is gross decimal win odds. Normalization makes sum_i q_ri = 1 within each race.
definitions.probability_edge: EDGE_ri = p_model,ri - q_market,ri. A positive value means the model assigns a higher probability than the normalized market probability; it does not by itself imply positive EV.
definitions.realized_edge: realized_EDGE_ri = I(event occurred) - q_market,ri. EDGE calibration error in the fresh settlement is mean(model EDGE) - mean(realized EDGE).
definitions.expected_value: For a 1-unit ticket with executable gross decimal odds O, EV = p * O - 1. The break-even probability is 1/O. For complex bets, EV is not identifiable without the ticket-specific pre-bet combination price.
definitions.fractional_kelly: Full Kelly fraction f* = (p*O - 1)/(O - 1), then fractional/capped Kelly uses min(cap, max(0, c*f*)). Existing experiments used research-only caps/fractions; no real stake was placed.
definitions.roi: ROI = (gross return - stake) / stake. Official final KRA dividends already contain takeout, so cited official settlements did not deduct 20%/27% a second time.
definitions.mdd: Maximum drawdown is the largest peak-to-trough decline of the chronological bankroll or cumulative profit curve. The exact unit/wealth convention is identified by each source column.
definitions.sharpe: The cited per-bet sqrt(n) Sharpe is mean ticket return divided by its standard deviation times sqrt(number of bets); it is not an annualized financial Sharpe unless the source explicitly says so.
definitions.delta_ll: DeltaLL/race = mean_r[log p_model(winner_r) - log q_market(winner_r)]. Positive values mean lower winner log loss than the market.
definitions.brier_improvement: Brier improvement = market Brier - model Brier. Positive values favor the model.
definitions.uncertainty: Daily-block confidence intervals resample race dates to preserve within-day dependence. A point ROI above zero is not confirmed when its 95% interval includes zero.
definitions.holm_fdr: Holm controls family-wise error for a fixed family; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR controls the expected false-discovery proportion. Unadjusted positive cells are not promoted when adjusted tests fail.

evidence_scope_taxonomy.meaning: The time split may be OOS relative to a fit, but the block was inspected in earlier project rounds and cannot be called new confirmation.
Expanding/rolling fits respected chronology, but all dates were already available to prior work; useful for robustness, not independent replication.
Dates are after v11, but the additional 37 races were collected after seeing the initial 27-race result and the pooled 64 were not pristine preregistered confirmation.
Threshold/model selection was completed on VALID; no TEST or target outcome was used, so it is a locked hypothesis but not performance confirmation.
Protocols, models, validators, and watchers were frozen before the target results, but no target performance or settlement existed at inventory time.
Tests prove evaluator/formula/gate behavior only; they are not profitability evidence.

v11_locked_full_rank_seven_bets.selection: policy and model chosen on VALID, evaluated on TEST 2025-12-28 through 2026-08-09
v11_locked_full_rank_seven_bets.interpretation: Only place has a positive point ROI, and its interval includes zero. Exact-trifecta and quinella-place have intervals entirely below zero. No full-rank bet type is profit-confirmed.

v11_market_anchor.interpretation: Market-anchor probability estimates beat q by log loss, but all seven locked ROI intervals include zero. The largest point ROI, quinella +39.72%, misses confirmation because its lower bound is -3.30%.

v11_upset_feature_and_top_fraction.importance_method: Within-race or same-field-size race-block permutation on the upset-tail realized-edge objective, with daily-block uncertainty.
v11_upset_feature_and_top_fraction.interpretation: The 0.5% threshold is operational, not a statistical significance cutoff. Only four selected features have positive importance intervals, and even the selected-feature model produced no CI/FDR-confirmed profit.

odds_8_15_evidence.conclusion: The band remains a useful research segment, especially for place-market loss defense, but neither v11 TEST nor H11C VALID establishes positive absolute profit.

h6_place_calibration.interpretation: Calibration improved proper scores before multiplicity correction but worsened Kelly return; calibration alone did not create an economic edge.

h7_clinic_ablation.interpretation: clinic_30d ranked high in permutation importance but its incremental contribution was not confirmed.

h8_later_date_fresh64.interpretation: Later by date, but not pristine because pooled64 was an optional continuation after seeing initial27.

h11e_prior_best_feasibility.reason: Required clinic/training/equipment/track and chronology-safe histories could not be exactly reconstructed from authorized pre-race sources; median/proxy guessing was explicitly rejected.

h17_ridge_convex_pool.interpretation: Regularization stabilized weights but shrank the challenger almost entirely back to the market; the remaining advantage was small and unconfirmed.

h12_h15_h16_h18_evaluator_readiness.interpretation: These PASS results establish implementation/gate readiness only. They contain no target-date ROI, EV, hit rate, dividend, or market-superiority evidence.

prospective_20260823_snapshot_at_invento.interpretation: No target-date performance claim can be made from this snapshot. Watcher files are mutable while the scheduled jobs remain active.

deep_and_stack_defensive_evidence.interpretation: This is the clearest loss-defense segment, but it fails 5% FDR, uses reused TEST and closing prices, and turns more negative under payout haircuts.

historical_superseded_or_nonconfirmatory.boundary: Probability advantage was positive; +32.69% ROI was not confirmed and did not reproduce at the same magnitude on current v11.
The same file explicitly states the policy was selected on the same historical data; not an OOS profit estimate.
The audit says its policy grid covers only part of total research degrees of freedom; treat it as a lower bound on selection bias.
Seoul-only and later found to contain final-pool features in the 137-feature path; current v11 evidence supersedes deployment claims.

price_fee_kelly_and_slippage_limitations.fee_handling: Official final dividends already reflect pool takeout, so all official settlement tables avoid a second 20%/27% deduction. Older synthetic commission-hurdle analyses state their assumptions separately.
price_fee_kelly_and_slippage_limitations.decision_time_prices: Closing/result win odds are not documented executable T-5 quotes. They may differ materially from bet-time prices.
price_fee_kelly_and_slippage_limitations.complex_bet_grid: A safe official pre-race full combination grid was not verified for place, exacta, quinella-place, trio, or trifecta. Only previously observed win/quinella paths were retained, and their public contracts remain result-capable.
price_fee_kelly_and_slippage_limitations.kelly: Kelly is directly identifiable only when ticket-level pre-bet price exists. Complex-bet Kelly entries are correctly marked unavailable; applying q-derived proxy odds would not establish executable EV.
price_fee_kelly_and_slippage_limitations.slippage: Existing payout-haircut sensitivity shows that near-zero absolute ROI deteriorates quickly. Example: reused-TEST 8-15 place ROI moves from -0.37% at no haircut to -20.29% at a 20% haircut.

failures_and_limits: No bet family has a validation-locked or later-date absolute ROI whose 95% interval is wholly above zero after applicable multiplicity control.
The fresh64 block has only 6 race days; exact sign-flip p-values have 1/64 resolution and wide ROI intervals.
The additional fresh37 block was collected after the initial27 result; pooled64 is an optional continuation, not pristine confirmation.
High complex-bet point ROIs are driven by very few winners and often collapse when the largest hit is removed; winning-ticket dividends alone cannot identify pre-bet EV for all losing tickets.
H11C H11B darkhorse thresholds did not beat equal-count q controls even on the VALID selection block; Holm passed cutoffs were 0/4.
Calibration improved log loss/Brier before adjustment but worsened Kelly return from -0.81% to -18.83%.
clinic_30d was the largest permutation-importance feature but ablation intervals included zero, so importance is not incremental-value confirmation.
H13/H14 stacking weights were unstable across time windows; H17 ridge regularization improved stability by shrinking almost entirely back to q, leaving only a tiny unconfirmed DeltaLL.
The historically strongest 29-feature model could not be prospectively scored without guessing 23 feature definitions/sources; the project correctly blocked it.
One target race day cannot establish long-term ROI, MDD, Sharpe, or market superiority even after settlement.
As of this evidence snapshot, the 2026-08-23 forward trial was unresolved and contributed zero performance observations.
quantitative_insights: Information edge and trading edge diverge: positive DeltaLL appears across several anchors, while no seven-bet absolute-profit family is confirmed.

The most defensible current claim is relative loss defense, not profit: in reused OOS 8-15 place segments, model selection lost less than the same-race market control, but absolute ROI remained statistically indistinguishable from zero.

The market anchor is structurally valuable. Unanchored models were materially worse in early experiments, while residual corrections were small; H17 regularization placed about 98.08% exponent back on q.

Feature parsimony improved operational reproducibility but not economic performance: the six-feature M6 could be replayed exactly, yet it underperformed the five-feature model on fresh64 and lost across all seven post-hoc settlements.

The 8-15 segment should be retained as a hypothesis, not a proven rule. v11 point ROI was positive but uncertain; H11C VALID H11B cutoffs all lagged q controls; deep/fixed rolling place showed relative defense only.
Rare complex-bet payoffs create severe winner concentration. Point ROI and even payout-haircut survival do not replace daily-block uncertainty or genuine pre-bet price evidence.

Proper regularization provides a falsification result: when instability is penalized, the optimizer largely discards model residuals and returns to the market, suggesting the raw ensemble signal was weak relative to estimation noise.
